correctness.rationale: For iid uniform unit-circle points the ordered Dirichlet gaps equal iid Exp(1) variables divided by their sum. Convex support yields exactly H=1-cos(pi max gap), while perimeter gives D=2 sum(pi gap-sin(pi gap)), even when a gap exceeds pi radians. Taylor/Dirichlet moment control reduces covariance to pi^5/(6 n^4) Cov(M^2 U^-2,F3). The influence polynomial psi(x)=x^3-18x+12 has exponential mean zero, variance 360; the CLT yields normal perimeter variance 40 pi^6. Conditioning on the maximum at L+z gives truncated independent exponentials and an unchanged centered CLT, proving joint Gumbel-normal independence. Exact conditional E[sum psi(Ei)|M=m] = m^3-18m+12 -(n-1) exp(-m)/(1-exp(-m)) (m^3+3m^2-12m); its leading contribution gives Cov(M^2,sum psi)~2(log n)^4 and covariance constant pi^5/3. The ratio limit follows by Slutsky. Bounded independent quadrature and exact factorial-moment checks corroborate but do not prove the asymptotics.
residual_risks: A finite verifier is supporting evidence rather than proof of the complete infinite statement.
